Overview

Sacramento is a city in CA with a population of 524,943. California’s capital with farm-to-fork dining, cheaper than Bay Area, and hot summers. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 269 sunny days a year.
